tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Find Contact Improvisation events worldwide: festivals, workshops, intensives, retreats, long jams, residencies, jams and classes. Upcoming by default; a past 'from' date also searches ended events. Use for questions like 'CI festivals in Germany this summer', 'workshops with <teacher>' or 'when was X last year'. Filter by country, city, dates, type, practice or free text. Returns up to 20 events sorted by start date, each with id and citreasurehunt.com URL, plus the total match count. Call get_event for prices, teachers and the full description.

country.description: Country as ISO code ("PT") or English name ("Portugal").

from.description: Window start, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today. Includes events still running on or after this date; a past date also returns ended events.

to.description: Window end: the latest start date, YYYY-MM-DD.

practice.description: Practice tag, e.g. "contact_improvisation" (default), "conscious_dance", "axis_syllabus", or "any" for all practices.

query.description: Free text matched against title, description and place, e.g. a teacher's name or 'silent'.

features.description: Only events offering all of these, e.g. ["residential", "meals"] or ["sliding_scale"].

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Get the full listing of one event: dates and times, venue and address, description, prices, teachers, organizers, level, languages, features and where people sleep. Use after search_events, or when the user gives a citreasurehunt.com event link. Accepts the event id (e.g. 'W27r') or the URL.

id.description: Event id (e.g. 'W27r'), its slug, or its citreasurehunt.com URL.

tools.name: search_teachers
tools.description: Find Contact Improvisation teachers, organizers and musicians by name, or by where they are based. Use for 'who teaches CI in <city>' or to look up a person mentioned in an event. Returns short profiles with slug and URL; call get_teacher for the full bio and their upcoming events.

query.description: Name or words from their bio.

country.description: Where they are based, ISO code or English name.

tools.name: get_teacher
tools.description: Get one person's public profile: bio, where they are based, practices, years of experience and their upcoming events. Use with a slug from search_teachers or from a get_event teacher link.

tools.name: search_venues
tools.description: Find dance studios and retreat centers that host Contact Improvisation classes, jams and events, by name, country or city. Use for 'where is CI taught in <city>' alongside search_communities. Returns venues with slug and URL; call get_venue for the address and upcoming events.

query.description: Venue name or words from its description.

tools.name: get_venue
tools.description: Get one venue's public details: address, description, website and the upcoming events it hosts. Use with a slug from search_venues or from a get_event venue link.

tools.name: search_communities
tools.description: Find local Contact Improvisation communities, the groups that run regular weekly jams and classes, by country, city or name. The primary tool for 'where can I dance CI in <city>' or 'is there a CI jam in <city>'. Returns communities with slug and URL; call get_community for details.

query.description: Community name or words from its description.

tools.name: get_community
tools.description: Get one local community's public details: what it runs, where, in which languages, the people and venues involved, and events it organizes. Use with a slug from search_communities. Group chat invite links and contacts are only on the community's page, not returned here.
